scripts.dev:server: npm run build:protocol && npm run dev -w @chitchak/server
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:protocol && npm run dev -w @chitchak/desktop
scripts.dev: npm run build:protocol && concurrently -n server,desktop -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @chitchak/server" "npm run dev -w @chitchak/desktop"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build:protocol && npm run infra:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.prod:migrate: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file .env.production --profile tools run --rm migrate
